page: Microsoft Azure E128-64ds_v6 is an Edsv6-family virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 64 dedicated vCPUs. The server is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU. For local storage, the instance includes 7559 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, and it is premium storage capable. No GPUs are bundled with this configuration, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local NVMe SSD storage, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require fast local scratch space or caching. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of both RAM and local NVMe storage makes it a specialized resource-dense option, reducing the need to provision additional instances solely for memory or storage capacity. It is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise applications, and heavy data processing pipelines.
